nom: RoC Retinol Correxion Anti-Wrinkle Retinol Face Serum with Hyaluronic Acid

avis.texte: I've been on the hunt for a good retinol that doesn't cost too much. I saw results on my laugh lines after one application and continued to see them as time went on. My wrinkles almost disappeared until I switched to another product. I never should have done that because Roc is the GOAT.

I'm in my 60's and I've tried every brand out there. I previously spent $250 at a dermatologist office thinking finally something tried and true for wrinkles. Nope, that didn't work. Well, ROC works. It's the best on the market. I immediately saw an improvement. In a week I saw about 20% lesser lines. This is the first time I've ever had an anti-aging product work so good! The only thing they could do to improve it is to take out the fragrance. It doesn't need it. It's that good.
What a great product. My face feels so tight and has less wrinkles. You will not be sorry if you purchase this. You will look and feel so much better.

avis.titre: Did not work on this 70 year old's deep wrinkles
avis.texte: I tried this product for a year, but my deep wrinkles seem to be highly resistant to it. But then I'm over 70 years of age and wasn't expecting miracles, just that they would look softer. I had better results using RoC's Deep Wrinkle Serum which I am using now. I gave it 2 stars because I do not want to discourage women younger than me from trying it. At their age this product may more easily treat their wrinkles as opposed to mine.

This product works to deminish lines around lips, forehead and eyes. Saw improvement in about 3 weeks. Easy to apply. A little goes a long way. Easy to apply, tube can be rolled so very little waste. Good directions and description. Reasonable price compared to other similar products

avis.titre: Works great - but proceed with caution
avis.texte: I recommend starting out with a product that doesn't contain as much retinol as this one. This cream is for the experienced - for someone whose been using retinol for awhile. Works great but can burn your skin if you're not careful. Caution

I have been using this product as directed for 3 months and have seen no improvement. I kept thinking maybe I'm not using enough (frequency or amount per application) and nothing has changed. I know products can take time to begin working, but based on other reviews and product claims, I thought to see a change by now.

I used this product on the deepest wrinkles found near my mouth and chin area. There was definite improvement in the first two weeks. The deepest wrinkles are less prominent. I had no adverse reaction using it once a day as well. Since I'm in my third week, I plan to try it out at night as well.

avis.titre: I am not happy with items that I bought
avis.texte: I am not happy with my purchase and i want to return and when i talk with specialist over the phone she said some person call from office and direct me what should l order
Did not see any results after60 days of use!!waste of money'n

I assessed the product performance over a two week period. While it provided excellent moisture and hydration as well as gentle exfoliation, I saw no improvement in fine lines and wrinkles. I usually give a product a minimum of 4 weeks before I perform a total assessment of performance. Had this product been allowed an extra 2 weeks, I feel it would be a great performer

I started using RoC products two years ago and they do work but it takes time to see dramatic results. I have used this retinol correction anti-wrinkle serum for two years and it had reduced my forehead, lip lines, neck lines and the deep wrinkles between my eye brows quite a lot. I took close to a year of daily use to see a decrease. I'm 51 and don't go out in the sun so this has helped as well. My skin was sensitive to it within the first two weeks but that diminished over time. I highly recommend these products.
This stuff really works. It goes on smooth and absorbs well. I use it every night and wake up in the morning to glowy smooth skin.
I bought this thinking it would be complete protection agains more wrinkles and damage. If you use this products night cream then use this you risk a facial burn

I used to love this product. They changed the packaging to a metal squeeze tube and it doesn't matter how lightly you squeeze the tube, so much product gets wasted from how quickly it oozes out. 2 thumbs down. Go back to the old packaging.
This is some good stuff. Love that I can wear it under make up and it doesn't affect the application at all.

avis.titre: Try this and you will like the results!
avis.texte: Wrinkles have lessened and skin looks healthier. I am using this around the outside of my mouth. -those fine lines one gets.
I have also used the filler serum. This one seems to fill more lines
This product is lightweight and a great daily use product. My skin feels fresh and hydrated. I've been using morning and night, have noticed more even skin overall.
I saw results after 2 weeks. I used to have 2 deep vertical wrinkles in between my eyebrows and they're almost invisible now. It's very hydrating and smooth. Highly recommend this product!!

The cream Works amazing but unfortunately the new packaging is horrible.. the tubes gets pierced very easily causing the product to not only be wasted but make a huge mess. I wish they were still packaged the same.
I bought this product but forgot to use until this past week! I'm hooked now because my deep wrinkles look SO much smoother with this product! Love it for AM and PM.
I love this product! It really works and almost immediately!!

I started noticing 11 and forehead lines at 29. I've always heard that ROC was the way to go for wrinkles. I purchased a tube of this and religiously use it on my forehead, every night before bed. It has kept my premature wrinkles at bay. I've tried the ordinary's retinol serum, not only was it super drying (it's straight retinol) but I didn't notice any difference. As soon as I went back to ROC, my wrinkles were smoother. I have super sensitive, oily and acne prone skin and this hasn't bothered it at all. I've been using this product for a year and I'm on my second tube. I highly recommend this!
My forehead lines are diminishing, but not as well as I was hoping. I was hoping for longer lasting results and a better feel. It does smell good and looks like it works right when you put it on

avis.titre: Love the product, packaging is terrible
avis.texte: The Product itself is great. The tube is terrible, it cracks and leaks product. This is my second purchase. Both tubes did the same. If they change the packing, I'll purchase again.
My complexion is more even and wrinkles have greatly improved in appearance.

I am on my second tube and I absolutely love it. I tried ROC on a whim and I'm not going back. My skin definitely absorbs this cream and loves it. I can definitely see a significant difference since I've started using this retinol. I'll be purchasing my 3rd tube soon.

It didn't work at all ..￼ as far as the cream goes it did nothing for me . Usually if a cream doesn't work I use it for my feed or hands or other parts in my body. I didn't even soften those parts. Maybe I got a bad product?

This product is honestly the best wrinkle product I've ever used. Within the first week, my forehead wrinkles were slim to none. I LOVE paulas choice products but I have to say, this ROC retinol product is better than the PC retinol. I'll def buy again.
Not a item I would purchas again as after a week it has shown NO change

Being 67 years old and making the decision to not use fillers or Botox, I really appreciate that this product does ease wrinkles. My eleven lines and lip lines don't appear as deep. I use it morning and night and can notice a difference if I miss an application.
So far it seems to be working for me. I would buy this product again.

I have two deep wrinkles on my forehead that have always been bothersome. After only two applications, these deep wrinkles have markedly improved. I have never had results like this before with any product. I can't believe the difference in just two days!!! This is the real thing!! It really REALLY works!
For mature skin, creams, serums will not do it! Treatments will have to be used first.
I have used many years. I feel it helps smooth my skin texture.

avis.titre: It's been a week but seems to be working
avis.texte: Just be careful, it may cause some irritation but it does look like my lines as less noticable - in a WEEK! Amazing. Used offers to get a discounted rate but I would totally pay full price. A teeny bit goes a LONG way! This is a spot treatment so the small container is a good reminder not to over do it
I've used RoC for years, I'm 72, but people tell me I don't look it.

I am so impressed with this correction cream , it definitely fills in and re-plumps your eyes and around my lips . I look years younger, I've only been using this for a couple of months and let me tell you…it works . The price is awesome and for what this product accomplishes you can't go wrong. I'm a customer for life . I've told all my friends about it, but they keep asking me if I've had a " little work" done.

Retinol Correction Serum is a part of my daily skincare routine. I can feel it working once I begin massaging it into my skin. I only use ROC skincare products on my aging skin. I use this morning and night and love it! When I ran out for a few weeks, I noticed a visual difference in my skin. Sun spots that had faded while using ROC products were more noticeable until I started back on ROC products.
I saw an immediate change from creases to much smoother skin. love it

This is very slippery. I'm 50 combo skin. I think using on really dry areas like around eyes useful but other areas no. It didn't fill anything for me. I think a pore filling primer would be better. Also it's a little shiny which emphasized the 11 line on my forehead.
I have been using this for over a year. It seems to do what it is advertised to do

This cream works great. I have dry and sensitive skin, but this doesn't break me out or irritate my skin at all. I love it and how it is helping get rid of my wrinkles, but I hate the strong smell. If it wasn't for the scent, I would give this 5 stars. It is so strong and smells like perfume. I hate the smell, but the product works so well, I try to ignore it.
Only been using a couple of weeks but I can see the difference

avis.titre: Great for the wrinkles on my neck!
avis.texte: I am almost 40, and I am lucky to have very minimal signs of aging - no wrinkles on my face, and I am religious with my skin care. OTC adapalene is my go to, and I have been using it for a over a year on my face and neck nightly. My skin is smooth and people always tell me I look much younger than I am. That said, I do have some lines on my neck that are deeper than I would like for them to be. In fact, if they could go away completely, that'd be ideal. I have been using this Roc Deep Wrinkle filler to fill the lines on my neck and after just 2 days, applying the filler 2X per day, my lines have diminished significantly. I am so happy! Because no matter how young my face looks, my neck gives my age away. So if I see improvements already, I cant wait to seehow my neck is looking a month from now. Anyways, the prodict is amazing, and I highly reccomd to anybody who has some deeper lines they'd like to target.
I am 80 years old and my ID is always questioned as I appear about 60..62. I have used ROC every night for 20 years. I think it is great stuff
Really works! I love it and will order next time. Recommend!

avis.titre: Works, but not a miracle cream
avis.texte: Have been using for 4 months. I'm 50 and wanted to improve a vertical line between my brows and forehead lines. I did an experiment and only used on one side of my forehead for 3 months. You can see a difference between the two sides if you look for it. I will keep using and hope for continued improvement. On the plus side, it is affordable. It didn't cause skin irritation it does not have strong odor. But it's no miracle cream.
Light, and absorbs quickly. I've noticed some wrinkle reduction after just a few weeks.
If you have any doubts, try it for 2 days and you'll see the difference. I was stunned at the results and highly recommend this product!
Using it on my wrinkles especially my forehead. Seem a less prominent. Says takes about 4 weeks to get full results. So we shall see.
I bought this product a week ago and already notice an improvement in my skin. I can't wait to see what long term use will do!

I have been using this in my skincare routine that also includes the Meaningful Beauty youth activating melon serum. Between the two products my fine lines have completely vanished! I am just AMAZED!!!!!
I do not smoke. Yet I have (had) very visible lines around my mouth & eyes. This had made those lines less visible. I use it religiously. (All around my lips/mouth and my eyes and frown lines)

I bought this a couple months ago after trying countless brands high and low end. This is the first product I can say that has faded my brown spots and is helping to reduce marionette lines! Will continue to use your brand ......love it!

I've been using the Deep Wrinkle Filler for less than a week and can already notice improvement in the lines around my mouth and a deep wrinkle I have between my eyes. I'm 55 years old and don't expect miracles or quick fixes. This product has already provided improvement and I'm excited to see what the results will be with continued use!! I'm hesitant to try new products, but sure am glad I did. I highly recommend this filler.

After 2 weeks of daily use I m starting to notice the improvement and getting compliments from my coworkers about the change on my lines around the eyes and mouth.Cant be happier after hesitating on buying this filler for a lot less money than many others that did not work on my sun damaged and aged skin. I m 45 years old and tried many fillers before without results.
I just started using this a few days ago. I don't notice to .much difference right now
I love this product as it definitely reduces the appearance of my fine lines & deep wrinkles.
I have been using this product for years. I am totally impressed at what my Skin looks like. I stand behind your product 110 percent. Thank you! One happy 57 year old.

avis.titre: An amazing product sitting on that shelf
avis.texte: I usually do not waste my money on products like this. Wrinkle this or wrinkle that however, I was however I was given a tube .. Within the first day I could have sworn my face looked smoother but I did not believe. Then only 3 or 4 days later I swear my face wa s way younger looking. Omg, this is what I am willing to pay more money for. It's priced right at the top of my budget and that's OK. I love all of the products from this kind. Would buy again. Will buy again

I looked up a ton of the ingredients in this product before buying and they were all good so I purchased. It's not bad and doesn't irritate my eyes but it also doesn't seem to moisturize, or fill in any wrinkles/ fine lines. I also felt like I had to use a lot to ensure I wouldn't be tugging at my eyes. Wouldn't recommend.

This is most-likely because I didn't buy the version for Sensitive Eyes, but nonetheless, I used this like it told me to and my eyelids in just a few days began to sting and burn and get flaky/scaly. Couldn't even put concealer on my eyelids for a solid week until it cleared up. Taking my makeup off with that skin irritation was actually so painful. I use waterproof mascara too. Use the sensitive skin one, or just use it very conservatively.

I don't usually review products , but I can't tell you how impressed I am with this ! I have smoker lines around my lips and after putting this on the first time , they significantly erased them ! I'm sure after constant use , it will even be better . I'm very happy with this product ! thank you !!

I was leery to try the deep wrinkle serum all over my face since I have sensitive skin. Many reviewers said their skin burned. I decided to try this product since I can put directly on the wrinkles I want to target. I did feel a slight burning sensation after applying a small amount to a very deep wrinkle, but it quickly faded and my skin was fine. I started applying this cream to one deep wrinkle twice a day. After 24 hours, I thought I could already see a difference (but maybe it was only wishful thinking). It's been ten days and my deep wrinkle is barely noticeable. Since I've had no negative reaction to this product, I started using on my forehead wrinkles and the wrinkles around my mouth. I apply up to three times a day. This product really, really works and is a terrific value for the money. Yesterday I bought the retinol correxion eye cream. I already see a very slight improvement in the dark circles under my eyes. I highly recommend the deep wrinkle and eye creams. You won't be disappointed.

avis.titre: you HAVE to use twice a day!
avis.texte: I was using this for a couple weeks at night only and wasn't seeing any results. I was mad I spent that much money for 0 results and was confused why I even bought it. But I read the reviews again and someone said they used it twice a day and saw results so I did morning and night and my under eyes looked so much better. I took off a star only because my deep forehead wrinkles didn't improve as much as my eyes.
I tried this for a wrinkle between my eyes and along my marionette lines. it didn't work at all for me. it just made me breakout on my forehead

I HAVE BEEN USING THIS PRODUCT FAITHFULLY FOR MORE THAN A YEAR AND HAVE NOT SEEN ANY RESULTS SO FAR. IF ANYTHING, IT'S CAUSING ME TO BREAKOUT. I AM NOT SURE IF IT'S THE INGREDIENTS OR IF IT'S JUST NOT COMPATIBLE WITH MY SKIN TYPE BUT IT HAS NOT WORKED FOR ME SO FAR. I SAW ALL THE POSITIVE REVIEWS BEFORE DECIDING TO TRY IT OUT. IF IT HASN'T WORKED FOR MORE THAN A YEAR I HAVE BEEN USING IT, THEN IT DEFINITELY WILL NOT WORK FOR ME IT SAYS IT WILL WORK AFTER 4 WEEKS OF USING BUT MORE THAN ONE YEAR AND NOTHING TO SHOW FOR IT.

avis.titre: I will continue to buy this product
avis.texte: After reading the other reviews and directions for use, I used this product twice daily, and love it. Seems to have helped with the wrinkles under my eyes! Awesome!

I'm a Cancer Survivor which was detected on my tonsil......removed as a kid but grown back! I have gone through very extensive Radiation and Chemo that have left a lot of damage. I lost my teeth due to the shifting of my jaw and developed wrinkles.....I should enter Guinea Book of Records.....no not THAT bad! I'm hoping this product will help me. Any suggestions would be appreciated! Thanks!

avis.titre: I would but this product again. It helps reduces the lines
avis.texte: This is an ellexcent product for maturing dry skin. It actually works to reduced lines. It does not get rid of them, it reduces them - even deep lines. Helps with hydration and I only use in the areas that it is needed. First few days I used it day and night, noticed the difference right away. Now I only use it at night. I like it to set in for a few minutes before I apply my night cream. Also a ROC product.
MY WIFE USES THIS CRAM AND SHE SWEARS BY IT. I WOULD GIVE IT A HEARTY RECOMMENDATION. WORTH EVERY PENNY
I use this under my eyes for wrinkles. It smooths out my skin and minimizes my deep wrinkles without that tightening feeling. Its one of the best products for crows feet I have ever used.

I used this daily on my face and neck. It has been less than a week and I can already see my forehead creases and laugh lines filling in. It's my first time using this product. Other products I've used (olay, ponds, etc.)did nothing for my skin. It irritates my skin for a maybe a minute but then fades. It does state this in the directions for use. I believe the earlier you start taking care of your skin the better because if you wait too late in life there's no going back.

avis.titre: The longer you use it ,the better it works
avis.texte: I've been using RoC for a while now and I've learned that the longer you use it the better it works, because of the Retinol that's in it. This little tube last for a long time, a little goes a long way. I've noticed a difference in the fine lines around my eyes, they are beginning to fade and my skins appearance is more healthy looking. I recommend this product and really love the brand.

avis.titre: NOT for Older ladies with "marionette" lines around mouth !!
avis.texte: I'm 67 & should have known better than to believe something would work on my deep Marionette Lines from my nose to my chin. There really is not a product that can help this kind of deep wrinkle. I wish the product would have approached that area in the disclosure info. I used a whole tube around my mouth only (so that took a long time). Not 1 iota of a difference. Ladies with this horrid problem need not waste $ on this so called "filler". I was a sucker for the word & I even knew better. Shame on me.

i just recently bought this product it is a little pricy but well worth it for someone my age it does decrease the wrinkles apperance wether you use it alone or put makeup ovr it but it dos decrease the appearnce of them i like it and would defintely buy it again
This is such an awesome product, it filled in some of my fine lines and I looked a lot healthier, which made me feel spectacular. It is a little pricey but well worth it!

I have been using this for a week. It does instantly do a good job of filling in my forehead and smile lines. I have noticed with twice daily use, the lines appear a little fainter as well. I'd like to see what it does after using a few more weeks. This is not greasy feeling. It's light and absorbs quickly. I will absolutely keep using this.
i tried it and it did not rid them but I did notice it not as bad when smile I am only 30 so I like to still do skin care for the past 4 years so i can be less wrinkles from the sun and aging
I tried this product years ago and didn't get the results I wanted but this time it's working, and I love it.

I loved it. It fills in my creases and re-plumps my skin. My wrinkles are less noticeable, even my deep wrinkles. It also contains Hyaluronic acid to help hydrate my skin it feels softer and smoother I would definitely recommend this product to my friends

avis.titre: RoC Ret Correxion Deep Wrinkle Filler !
avis.texte: I waited to write my review regarding this product so that i could see if it really worked. 4 weeks later i can actually say it does. The first day i tried RoC Retinol Correxion Deep Wrinkle Filler i noticed how nice it felt on my skin, so i used it twice a day, morning and nite and started to see my crows feet get lighter and lighter. I liked the way i looked and i liked what Roc Retinol Correxion Deep Wrinkle Filler did to my fine lines and wrinkles. This is a great product that actually delivers on its promise. This is defintely a keeper and i will continue to use it. Thank you RoC for making a product that ACTUALLY keeps its promise

RoC Retinol Correxion Eye Cream is for Anti-Aging and fights the signs of aging around your eyes. It has a nongreasy feeling and it is a moisturizing cream that is specially made to use around the eye area. It will reduce the look of dark circles under your eyes and puffiness in four short weeks!

avis.titre: Roc is the foundation of facial beauty
avis.texte: RoC Retinol Correxion Deep Wrinkle Filler is the best over the counter anti-aging cream/filler that money can buy.Saw results quickly as the deep forehead wrinkles seem to visibly fade.Instant smoothness without any greasy residue.Mild fragrance and I had no sensitivity at all.My skin looks a few years younger to me and been asked if I have a secret potion for skin care.For me Roc is greatly improving my face wrinkles everyday of use and I want to thank the Home Tester Club for the oppurtunity to test this great product and providing a full size tube to use so I am able to really tell the difference before and after.This trial worked so well for that I have a full line of RoC products purchased to continue my skin care regime.

avis.titre: Roc Retinol Correxion For Deep Wrinkles
avis.texte: I feel that the Roc Retinol Correxion Deep Wrinkle Filler really did lessen the appearance of deep wrinkles.It is easy to use, leaves my skin feeling soft and smooth and makes my face look younger because the wrinkles are not as prominent. I would definitely use it again and tell others to try it,it works.

avis.titre: Great way to improve your skin
avis.texte: It made my skin feel tighter. I noticed an immediate difference. The wrinkles were no longer as noticeable. I will definitely continue to use Retinol Correxion.

avis.titre: This Is My New Favorite Product
avis.texte: I have been using the Roc Retinol product for over two weeks. I immediately noticed that the skin around my eyes and lips was softer. After 1 week , the lines at the corners of my eyes were less noticeable and after 2 weeks the tiny lines around my mouth seemed smaller. I will continue to use this product as I am happy with the results .

I love ROC RETINOL CORREXION DEEP WRINKLE because my skin looked all the time so dry and since I am using it my skin looks much better. I mean specially the wrinkles are not so deep now and my skin is always soft, shiny (not greasy shiny). I have been applying the cream 2 times at nights because you can be expose at the sun. Thank you so much for sending me this product I will buy when I finish my sample.
Awesome, saw a deference in just a couple of days. It helped fill the many wrinkles from being in the elements all the time. I would definitely recommend this product to others.............

I was really impressed with Roc RETINOL CORREXION® Deep Wrinkle Filler , I had been using Estee Lauder Wrinkle Cream for the last three years without any significant change. Within two full days ( four applications ) I was already noticing a difference in the appearance of my skin on my face , a more smooth texture was the most noticeable. My husband even told me it was babysoft again. By day 7 (24 applications ) my deep frown lines around my mouth seemed not as prominent , the same thing with my crows feet around my eyes . This lotion is truly a GEM , I have been on the lookout for one just such as this and I feel so lucky to finally found Roc , I would have to say my #1 favorite thing about it is the imediate face lift it gives you upon putting it on , my face feels tighter yet smooth and softer ready for makeup .Roc truly ROCKS !

When I applied the ROC Deep Wrinkle Filler to my face, the creases on my face begin to fill out and my skin began to re-plump itself. My skin felt smooth and the product sis not break my skin out. I liked this product.
Don't need to use a lot. A small amount goes a long way. I love the way it works.

I will never be without this product again! I love the glow that it gives my skin! The deep wrinkles on my forehead are so much better and the ones around my eyes and mouth are almost completely gone! I love that my husband has even noticed a difference in my skins appearance! This will be in gift bags for my sisters in their birthdays!

Roc Retinol is a great product. I immediately saw a difference with my small fine lines, I loved how it felt going on and the fragrance was soft. The only reason I didn't give it a grade A all the way across was I still haven't been using it long enough to see the deeper wrinkles go away completely. Although they look to be on their way.
It seemed to work some of the wrinkles so not so noticable but they are still visible. Seem to absorb quickly and no residue or gready feeling left behind.

avis.titre: Liked the RoC and will continue to use.
avis.texte: I enjoyed using the product and it seems to have helped the wrinkles on my forehead and some of the wrinkles by my eyes. I did not experience any burning from the product, which was a plus. I think using it with RoC face lotion would be a big benefit.
I really like this product. It helps my fine lines and wrinkles. Keeps my skin soft. Doesn't have a strong scent. I regret it if I skip a night of application.

I use ROC retinol for years - it's wonderful. I really didn't think the wrinkle filler would make any difference. I was surprise with the results . The furrow between my eyes are less noticeable as is the crows feet . I am definitely adding it to my daily routine.
Love this product and will defiantly buy and recommend to others.

avis.titre: RoC Retinol Correxion Deep Wrinkle Filler
avis.texte: I LOVE it! I have been using this for a few weeks and the results are great! The deep lines on my forehead are so much better and the small lines around my eyes are almost gone! My skin looks amazing since starting this lotion and I love the subtle scent and easy application. I will definitely continue using this!

Very good product. Promises confirmed! I have been using this for about three weeks now and have a very noticeable difference in the look and feel of the skin on my face and neck. Some wrinkles - GONE, some - much less noticeable. Provided the price is not outlandish I will continue to purchase this product.

It seems to be helping with a deep wrinkle by my mouth. I'm going to continue using it to see how much it helps. One of the reasons why I don't know if I like it is because you have to be careful about the sun.
